title: Establish SLO matrix for embeddings tier with progressive degradation and regional fallback policy
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: As more customers adopt Redwood for high-volume embedding workloads (search, semantic ranking), we need a dedicated SLO matrix and rollout gates for the embeddings tier that balance cost and availability. This ticket scopes the product requirements for defining latency bands, availability targets, and progressive degradation behaviors (e.g., inferred quantized model fallback, reduced batch sizes) plus a regional fallback policy when primary capacity is constrained.

Goals:
- Define clear SLOs for 3 workload classes: interactive embeddings (single-vector, low-latency), bulk embeddings (batched throughput jobs), and streaming/continuous ingestion.
- Specify error budgets, measurement windows, and alert thresholds tied to those SLOs.
- Design rollout gates and automated guardrails that trigger when SLO degradation crosses thresholds: canary aborts, automatic routing to cheaper/compatible model variant, and staged traffic shift back to primary.
- Create acceptance criteria and implementation handoff artifacts for Eng and Console teams.

Scope in: SLO targets (p95/p99 latency, availability), degradation behaviors (fallback model variant, batch-size reduction, cache bypass), rollout policy definitions (canary thresholds, rollback conditions), dashboards/alerts to surface SLO burn.

Scope out: Changes to billing model, long-term model tuning/retraining, on-prem packaging details for air-gapped customers.

Stakeholders: PM (owner), Serving Runtime Eng, Console Observability Eng, Solutions/SE, Support, Security (for any routing/audit changes).
acceptance_criteria: A published SLO matrix document that lists SLO values for interactive, bulk, and streaming embedding workloads including p50/p95/p99 latency targets, availability percentage, measurement windows, and error budget rates.
Defined escalation and alerting thresholds mapped to error budget burn rates (e.g., 25%/50%/75%/100%) with corresponding on-call actions and playbook links.
Rollout gate spec that includes: canary pass/fail criteria, automated rollback rules, and stepwise traffic shift percentages (e.g., 5/20/50/100) with minimum observation window per step.

Clear mapping of progressive degradation actions ordered by severity with intent and safety checks: (1) reduce batch size / increase parallelism param, (2) route to quantized-compatible variant, (3) serve cached vectors or stale embeddings with labeled response, (4) regional failover to secondary region with audit trail.
Console dashboard mockups and a curated set of three synthetic workloads (interactive, bulk, streaming) with baseline telemetry and test queries to validate SLO measurement pipeline.
Dependencies and handoff tickets created for Eng teams with acceptance tests defined (latency harness, regression tests, and chaos scenarios for regional failover).
tasks: Workshop with Serving Runtime leads to validate degradation actions and technical feasibility (PM + Eng)
Define canary and rollout gate thresholds and automate checks in deployment pipeline (Eng)
Design Console dashboard and alert rules (DX/Observability)
Create synthetic workload harness and baseline runs (Eng + QA)
Write customer-facing docs and internal playbook for SRE/Support (PM + Support)
Schedule security review for routing/audit changes (Security)
Handoff PRD and acceptance criteria to implementation epics (PM)
Post-launch 30-day burn-rate review and iterate SLOs if needed (PM + Eng)
